acts.palette: slate gray, chalk white, aged bronze, parchment cream, cloud gray, swarm teal
acts.map: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre. No logos, readable text, real people or copied website imagery. Tall vertical overhead papercraft diorama of an invented stone sundial garden and archive, read bottom to top: a broken dial and lamp at the entrance, scattered round dials and a cream folded-card bridge across a dark gap, then wooden hoops, sketch sheets and a narrow archive doorway. Keep a broad open stone middle ground for readable path lines. At the top, leave a clear circular slate court for the Grand Register; small teal hexagons creep up from cracks along the edges.
backdrops: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre. No logos, readable text, real people or copied website imagery. Wide, low-contrast fight background: a quiet slate courtyard with pale round sundials, long bronze paper shadows and gray clouds; a few teal hexagonal growths cling to outer stone seams. Open, uncluttered center; no central subject.

acts.boss: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre. No logos, readable text, real people or copied website imagery. Full-body Grand Register, an imposing towering slate cabinet raised on four long bronze legs, its broad tilted circular dial forming a shield over the cabinet mechanism. A ring of tiny triangular cutters surrounds the dial; angular feet and a wide crown make a strong, readable silhouette. Center the entire figure against a subdued plain backdrop, with room around every limb.
